Start dev.about: Starts the Next.js dev server in a Horadric pane and opens localhost:3000 in the Horadric browser once it answers

steps.say: The dev server is about to start on http://localhost:3000. Start a background Bash command (run_in_background) that polls it with curl until it answers, then end your turn right away. When that command finishes, open http://localhost:3000 in the Horadric browser with browser_open. Do nothing else.
